entities.title: GDExtension library (lodestar-godot)
entities.summary: The cdylib Godot loads through lodestar.gdextension; it registers the bridge's classes.
entities.purpose: A workspace crate built as a cdylib. Its entry point is the #[gdextension] ExtensionLibrary implementation; it re-exports SimHost so the class registration is linked in. desktop-build.md beside it records how the library and the exports are built.
boundaries: The runtime is Godot 4.7.2; the binding is godot-rust 0.5.5, pinned in the workspace and upgraded together with Godot.
